authorization.request: 用户要求优化 DSH Desktop 插件商城左右留白，并指出推荐榜和必装榜切换时顶部数据显示错误，允许实际操作测试；此前明确要求推送与合并商城修复。

objective: 修复推荐榜与必装榜切换时顶部数量标签共用当前榜单计数的问题，给商城主内容增加符合 DSH Desktop 的响应式左右留白，并将源码更新到 0.9.31。

runtimeReproduction.observedIn: running DSH Desktop, official plugin marketplace panel
runtimeReproduction.failure: Both labels showed the selected ranking count; cards themselves switched to the selected board.

change.storeViews: Create and memoize recommended and essential row arrays independently from the same verified website snapshot. Each tab label reads its own total count; selected-board search, category filtering, results, and pagination continue to use that board.
change.layout: Center the marketplace root and add responsive horizontal padding with CSS clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 30px), balanced vertical padding, and a 14px card-grid gap. Preserve the existing single scroll container and sticky search controls.
change.installAuthority: No install behavior changes. Store labels, review states, and ranking positions remain advisory; DSH Desktop official plugin manager continues to decide installation outcomes.
change.catalog: This source PR does not change the Catalog pin. Catalog remains 0.9.30 until a separate fresh Catalog policy plan is approved through its exact confirmation phrase.
change.runtime: Do not change DSH core or @deepseek-ai packages; do not write a real DSH Profile, install/update a real package, restart Desktop, or execute third-party source.

gates: The typed plan binds base Commit 0cc294ef0e20112314f6d8cdc8b6de25a489de6f, exact changed-file scope, base SHA-256 values, and reviewed postcondition hashes.

A disposable Desktop fixture with deliberately different recommended and essential totals verifies both labels after switching to either board and checks page rows against marketplace/rankings/model.js.
The Desktop component fixture verifies the root centered responsive insets, CSS clamp padding, and widened card gap; preserve the existing bounded scroll and sticky controls.
The official DSH Desktop 0.9.30 interface was operated to reproduce the existing count bug; it is not loaded with the proposed 0.9.31 source and does not count as acceptance of the fix.
The package version is 0.9.31 while the public Catalog stays at 0.9.30 until a separate policy publication. Never infer public release from this source PR.
Use disposable tests only. Do not mutate a real Profile, DSH package, or restart state. Revert through an auditable PR if health checks fail.
rollback: Revert only this source change through an auditable CI-checked PR. The Catalog remains pinned to 0.9.30; no Profile backup or restoration is needed because no real Profile or Desktop package is touched.
healthCheck: Require DSH_UPGRADE_PLAN_OK, 45/45 focused Desktop tests, npm run check with registry validation and all 592 tests, npm pack --dry-run for 0.9.31, node --check src/client.js, git diff --check, and exact-head PR CI. Separately verify the new Catalog publication and real Desktop acceptance later; neither is inferred here.

commands.expected: 45 disposable Desktop tests pass, including per-board counts, board contents, and responsive inset styling
REGISTRY_OK and all repository tests pass
